components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The primary action in a support workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e6bf5b; color: #183e37; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 14px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0d47e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #df715b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Input
components.description: Text field for customer inquiry input.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #295345; border-radius: 12px; background: #12352e; color: #e8f1e9; font: 400 14px/1.6 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #df715b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected destination in the evergreen app rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #e8f1e9; color: #124b45; text-align: left; font: 600 13px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #f7faf5; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #df715b; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-icon { font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Summary Card
components.description: Compact count or workflow shortcut on the overview.
components.css: .ds-summary-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #ccdcd2; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7faf5; color: #183e37; } .ds-summary-card strong { font: 700 24px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-summary-card span { color: #587d6c; font: 500 12px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Ticket Route
components.description: Connects intent, assigned team, and response target.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #183e37; font: 600 12px 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-route i { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 24px; height: 2px; background: #a4cbb8; } .ds-route i::after { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 2px solid #124b45; border-radius: 50%; background: #e6bf5b; content: ''; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

narrative.overview: TicketSense is an operational workspace, not a model demonstration. Its visual language borrows the legibility of civic route systems: an evergreen rail gives the app a stable home, a pale mineral surface keeps long work sessions comfortable, and warm markers distinguish the next step in a ticket's route. The interface keeps standard web navigation and controls. Its signature route line links predicted intent, assigned team, and response target without competing with the customer message. One documentary support-team photograph appears on the overview only.
keyCharacteristics: Evergreen navigation rail with a selected destination in pale green.
Open, pale work surface with restrained borders and compact operational labels.
Amber for primary action and route junctions; coral for urgent states.
The API and model evaluation tools are outside the agent-facing navigation.

rules.name: The Route Marker Rule
rules.body: Amber marks an action or an explicit route junction; coral is reserved for priority and error meaning.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate work areas with surface tone and spacing before adding shadow.

dos: Do keep classifier, batch triage, catalog, and SLA routing as distinct agent destinations.
Do keep the support-team photograph on the overview only.
Do preserve the model's result, assigned routing, confidence, and SLA values exactly.
donts: Don't bring model benchmarks or API controls into the agent navigation.
Don't use route colors decoratively; keep amber and coral tied to their named jobs.
Don't change the FastAPI contract from frontend presentation work.
